name: Me Brother, Nipsy

angles.text: Monty's pirate manner and eccentric delusions come from the trauma of the Gnomeregan incident. They show the personal toll the city's fall took on surviving gnomes.
Nipsy skewers fresh Deeprun rats into kabobs for travelers between Ironforge and Stormwind.
The Deeprun Tram links Stormwind and Ironforge with a high-speed route. Local vendors serve travelers at both depots.

faq.answer: Monty is an eccentric gnome at the Ironforge side of the Deeprun Tram. Deeply affected by Gnomeregan's catastrophe, he has taken up a pirate's speech and manner, though he has never seen an ocean. He catches live rats to send across the tramline.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Me Brother, Nipsy?

faq.answer: Nipsy is Monty's brother and runs a food stall at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot. He relies on Monty to send live rats across the tram tunnel for his rat kabob business.

aliases: what is carton of mystery meat
faq.answer: The Carton of Mystery Meat holds live Deeprun rats caught by Monty. Nipsy needs them to arrive alive so they will not spoil before he makes them into kabobs.
faq.q: What is inside the Carton of Mystery Meat?

aliases: why does monty talk like a pirate
faq.answer: Monty speaks like a pirate to cope with the trauma of the Gnomeregan disaster. Nipsy says Monty has never seen an ocean, though he clings to pirate mannerisms and warns travelers about losing limbs on the tram rails.
faq.q: Why does Monty speak like a pirate?

aliases: what does nipsy do with the rats
faq.answer: Nipsy makes and sells rat kabobs to travelers at the Stormwind depot. Fresh Deeprun rats arriving by tram keep his stall supplied.
faq.q: What does Nipsy do with the rats?

aliases: where do i take the meat
faq.answer: You carry the shipment on the Deeprun Tram from the Ironforge depot to the Stormwind terminal. The tram runs through the underwater tunnel to Nipsy's station on the Stormwind side.
faq.q: Where do you deliver the shipment?

sections.body: At the Ironforge station, Monty asks you to carry live rats through the Deeprun Tram to his brother Nipsy at the Stormwind depot. The short trip links the dwarven and human capitals beneath the mountains. Curious trades carry on along the way.
sections.title: A Subterranean Delivery

sections.body: The crate is labeled Carton of Mystery Meat, but inside are live Deeprun rats. Nipsy runs a rat kabob stall at the Stormwind terminal and needs the rats before they spoil. When the crate arrives intact and twitching, he is relieved to have food for travelers passing through the station.
sections.title: The Rat Kabob Trade

sections.body: Monty speaks in exaggerated pirate slang and warns travelers to keep their limbs aboard the tram. Nipsy says Monty has never seen an ocean in his life. Monty uses his pirate manner to cope with the lingering trauma of Gnomeregan's radioactive fall.
sections.title: Scars of Gnomeregan

summary: On the Deeprun Tram, Monty sends live rats to his brother Nipsy in Stormwind. Nipsy runs a rat kabob stall at the far terminal, while Monty's odd manner hints at Gnomeregan's tragedy.
attribution: In-game quest text: Me Brother, Nipsy
